attributes.name: cidr_block
attributes.description: Address range for this subnet. Must sit inside the parent VPC's CIDR and not overlap a sibling.

attributes.name: availability_zone
attributes.description: Zone to place the subnet in. Leave blank to let AWS choose.

attributes.name: map_public_ip_on_launch
attributes.description: Give instances launched here a public IP. This is what makes a subnet public, together with a route to an internet gateway.
